raw.question: Treat private mount state as the pending-writeback source of truth
raw.chosen: Treat private mount state as the pending-writeback source of truth
raw.reasoning: The public child snapshot historically derives pending counts from an obsolete in-mirror legacy file. Operator status now resolves the exact private state identity for each scope and counts dirty tracked files there.

retrospective.summary: Made aggregate writeback status count dirty files from each scope's persisted private mount state; regression proves bogus public pending counts are ignored.
